Studio edition · Easy and Manual

Emissions Tracking, built with brainfreeze studio

The Emissions Tracking agent on real SharePoint lists that hold the workshop's synthetic records, with its own managed app. Easy mode has brainfreeze studio build all of it; Manual mode builds the same thing by hand.

Synthetic data only: every record and figure is fictional workshop data, not customer results, verified emissions evidence, a compliance determination, or a credit purchase.

Use the same lists, agent and managed app in either mode. Keep the agent in Draft. Expected results below are checks to run, not claims that a live run has passed.

Progress remains available on this page but will not persist after you leave.
Found something inaccurate? Use Report an issue on that step. It opens a prefilled GitHub issue for your review and never submits automatically.

What you'll build

SharePoint lists

  • Emissions Facilities — 4 synthetic records Download facilities.csv
  • Emissions Carbon Offsets — 4 synthetic records Download carbon-offsets.csv
  • Emissions Regulations — 3 synthetic records Download regulations.csv

0 of 9 complete

1

Get the tools and sign in once

Step 1 of 9

Action

Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.

Expected result

The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

Command 1
git clone https://github.com/microsoft/aibast-agents-library.git
Command 2
npm install -g @microsoft/managed-apps-cli
Command 3
ms auth login
Command 4
az login
Screenshot pending

A real capture will be added after this step is run live and reviewed. No screenshot is shown; this is not evidence that the step has passed.

2

Build and deploy everything with one command

Step 2 of 9

Action

Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.

Expected result

It prints the three lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

Command 1
python3 -m brainfreeze_studio aibast emission-tracking --library ./aibast-agents-library --site https://<your-tenant>.sharepoint.com/sites/<your-site> --environment https://<your-org>.crm.dynamics.com --deploy

Manual mode: build it yourself

0 of 24 complete

1

Open a SharePoint site for the workshop data

Step 1 of 24

Action

Use a SharePoint site you can edit, or create one (SharePoint start page, Create site, Communication site) named AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual.

Expected result

The site's home page opens and you can create lists on it.

2

Create Emissions Facilities from its CSV

Step 2 of 24

Action

On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload facilities.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column and the measurements as Number, but scroll right and set BaselineYear to Single line of text (it is a year, so it should not show as 2,022). Name the list Emissions Facilities.

Expected result

A list with four fictional facilities and the columns FacilityId through BaselineCO2.

Download source: facilities.csv
3

Create Emissions Carbon Offsets from its CSV

Step 3 of 24

Action

New, List, From CSV with carbon-offsets.csv. On Customize, set Vintage to Single line of text (a year, not a quantity). Name it Emissions Carbon Offsets.

Expected result

Four fictional offset projects, including Appalachian Reforestation (OFF-001).

Download source: carbon-offsets.csv
4

Create Emissions Regulations from its CSV

Step 4 of 24

Action

New, List, From CSV with regulations.csv. On Customize, make sure Deadline is Single line of text. Name it Emissions Regulations.

Expected result

Three fictional reporting programs with their thresholds and deadlines.

Download source: regulations.csv
5

Create a blank agent

Step 5 of 24

Action

In Copilot Studio, create a new agent and skip the description flow.

Expected result

A new, empty agent opens on its Build page.

6

Name the agent

Step 6 of 24

Action

Rename it Emissions Studio Manual. (Agent names can be at most 30 characters.)

Expected result

The name shows at the top of the Build page.

7

Paste the studio instructions

Step 7 of 24

Action

Copy the whole instructions file and paste it into Instructions, replacing anything there. Then, in the last section (SharePoint site), replace YOUR_SITE_ADDRESS with your site's address, for example https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/AIBASTSyntheticDataManual. The list tools need it: Copilot Studio still asks the model for the site and list on every call.

Expected result

The instructions start with Emissions Tracking Agent — Studio Global Instructions, name the three list tools, and end with your site's address.

Download source: GLOBAL-INSTRUCTIONS.md

22

Register the app and connect the lists

Step 22 of 24

Action

In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.

Expected result

ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the three tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

Command 1
cd emissions-app/managed-app
Command 2
ms app init --display-name "Emissions Tracking Workspace Manual" --repo native
Command 3
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Emissions Facilities" --use-sso
Command 4
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Emissions Carbon Offsets" --use-sso
Command 5
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Emissions Regulations" --use-sso
